title: Havertys Furniture Announces Participation in Sidoti Small-Cap Virtual Conference

body_markdown:
ATLANTA


, Sept. 18, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- HAVERTY FURNITURE COMPANIES, INC. (NYSE:HVT and HVT.A) announced today that Steven G. Burdette, President and CEO, and Richard B. Hare, Executive Vice President and CFO, will participate in the Sidoti Small-Cap Virtual Conference on September 24th, 2026. To schedule a meeting, please contact your conference representative.


There will be a fireside chat presentation on September 24th, 2026, at 1:45 PM EST. The presentation will be available on the Events & Presentations page of the Investor Relations section of the company's website at[ir.havertys.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4777715-1&h=2150596592&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.havertys.com%2Fnews-events%2Fevents-presentation%2F&a=ir.havertys.com) .


**About Havertys** **Furniture** Havertys Furniture (NYSE:HVT and HVT.A), established in 1885, is a full-service home furnishings retailer with 130 showrooms in 17 states in the Southern and Midwestern regions, providing its customers with a wide selection of quality merchandise in middle to upper-middle price ranges. Additional information is available on the Company's website at[www.havertys.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4777715-1&h=3563167444&u=https%3A%2F%2Fpr.report%2Fd3ki&a=www.havertys.com) .
